item.title: Kansas lawmakers approve proposal to help Chiefs build new stadium across state line from Missouri
item.description: TOPEKA, Kan. (AP) — Kansas lawmakers approved a proposal Monday to help pay for a new stadium for the Kansas City Chiefs, which is expected to lure one of the NFL's iconic franchises across the state line from Missouri and replace popular but aging Arrowhead Stadium. item.title: Fort Leonard Troops treated to holiday day off in Lebanon
item.description: Over 100 service members from Fort Leonard Wood were treated to a day of fun and food in Lebanon, Missouri, hosted by the community to show their appreciation for the soldiers' service.

item.title: December delight now underway, warmest Christmas on record a possibility
item.description: Warm and humid air is spreading into the Ozarks, setting the stage for an unprecedented stretch of holiday heat with temperatures reaching record highs on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.

item.title: Springfield restaurants that will be open on Christmas Day
item.description: Black Sheep Burgers & Shakes is giving away free burgers from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at their downtown location, and many other restaurants in the Springfield area are open and ready to serve for the holidays.
